marc: Quick run results for adaptive-window sweep across us-west1/ap-northeast1 on h100 and rtx6000. Swept window 10-500ms and max_batch_tokens [512,1024,2048,4096]. Uploading raw numbers shortly.
perf-bot: perf-tests started: job jt-20260320-1 (params captured)
anya: Nice — did you enable fairness scheduling for these runs? e.g. --fairness=per-tenant?
marc: Yes. Baseline flags used for jt-20260320-1:
```
./runner --model redwood-v1-13b --device h100 --window 150ms --max-batch-tokens 2048 --fairness per_group
```
kai: Quick take: us-west/h100 sees ~18% p99 latency drop at window=100ms vs 500ms, throughput drops only ~6% — tradeoff looks promising.
zara: Any sign of quality regressions when using int8 quant+llm-int8?
marc: Ran eval set (1k prompts). No meaningful regressions: avg F1 delta <0.4%. Full eval artifact: https://redwood.test/reports/jt-20260320-1
ci-bot: Jenkins: artifacts uploaded s3://redwood-perf/jt-20260320-1/ (logs, csv, raw traces)
anya: Observed fairness issue: max_batch_tokens=512 increases tail for single-tenant spikes in ap-northeast1. Might need tenant-level isolation or token budget.
kai: Suggest trying adaptive backoff: window = min(150ms, 10 * avg_interarrival_ms) — should keep throughput while bounding tail.
marc: Agreed. Scheduling next run with --adaptive-window and --max-batch-tokens 1024. ETA ~20m.
perf-bot: job jt-20260320-2 queued (priority medium)
zara: Kernel knob idea: set prefer_fused_attention=true on RTX6000 for short sequences — could push up tokens/sec for ap-northeast run.
marc: Adding kernel toggle. Quick CSV summary from jt-20260320-1:
```
region,device,window_ms,max_batch_tokens,p50_ms,p95_ms,p99_ms,tokens_per_sec
us-west,h100,100,2048,12,46,78,42000
us-west,h100,500,2048,18,60,110,45000
ap-northeast,rtx6000,150,1024,20,80,160,21000
ap-northeast,rtx6000,150,512,22,120,260,19000
```
anya: Good summary. Can someone convert this into dashboard panels? ping @platform-observability
kai: I'll open a PR for the dashboard + add p99/p95 alert thresholds and link it here.
marc: Thanks — will post final notes + regression checks when jt-20260320-2 completes. :thumbsup:
